BefForandr: The model population changes is new from 2006 in the cost equalisation system for county councils.
Strukturkostnad: The sum of standard costs is not always exactly the same as the structure cost. The structure cost is rounded off.
The structure cost is the sum of each municipality or county councils standard cost (the  outcome in each model)
Utfall: The outcome for each munisipality and county council is the difference between the own structure cost and the average structure cost in Sweden.

1996: Until 1996 was Dalarnas läns county council called Kopparbergs läns county council.
1999: 1999 was Västra Götalands läns county council formed. It succeeded Bohus county council, Älvsborgs läns county council, skaraborgs läns county council and Göteborgs municipality. The same year did Skåne läns county council succeed Kristianstads läns county council, Malmöhus läns county council and Malmö municipality.
2000: Grantyear 2000 did the calculations for the cost equalisation change.
Year 2000 did almost every model change.
2002: Higher education is not a part of the cost equalisation for county councils since 2002.
2005: The cost equalisation was revided in year 2005. The model for  sparsely populated countys is no longer included in the cost equalisation. The models for public transport and health- and medical care has been changed.
Year 2005 did all models change. Comparisons with earlier years shall be done with caution.
2005 where some changes in the names of the models.
2006: The model population changes is new from 2006 in the cost equalisation system for county councils.
2007: From january 2007 did the municipality of Heby change county from Västmanland to Uppsala.
